title: Nutrition and Soccer for Pediatric Overweight and Obesity
brief_summary: This study will examine whether two months of youth soccer, combined with a single brief behavioral/nutritional intervention, can reduce BMI in 5th grade overweight or obese females.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* obese or overweight 4th grade public school student in Starkville

Exclusion Criteria:

* unable to run or physical disease or disability
